notes: Variadic special builtins print/to_string/error (axis.w:2504 special operators, 8773+ wrappers; shared_variadic_builtin, never in the global overload table nor startup completions). to_string concatenates component displays with strings unquoted; print displays the argument tuple verbatim (strings quoted) and RETURNS it as value; error concatenates stripped text and raises runtime error with that message. Zero-arg forms: to_string()->"", print()->prints (), error()->empty runtime message. Used pervasively by atlas-scripts (to_string in 30+ files).
